notes: Smarter death-ward/deathblock avoidance: instead of firing three blind instakills to learn a mob is immune, the caster now watches whether the target SURVIVES the cast — two confirmed survivals of a death effect and it stops wasting that spell family on the mob. A cast that actually kills never counts, so it learns faster and truer. (Death ward/deathblock can't be read directly off a target — the SDK exposes no per-target effect list — so this behavioral check is the accurate way to detect it.)
